rules.recommended_action: Review the date of birth recorded in Aadhaar
rules.explanation: The complete date of birth in Aadhaar differs from another uploaded document.
exact_steps: Verify the date against the original birth record.
If you choose to review Aadhaar, use the current UIDAI update process with an accepted Proof of Birth.
rules.exact_support: UIDAI describes date-of-birth update limits and update procedures.
rules.disclaimer: Nirdosh Vault identifies a conflict but does not decide which date is legally correct.

rules.recommended_action: Aadhaar shows only the year of birth (Declared DOB)
rules.explanation: The year agrees, but Aadhaar does not contain enough information for an exact full-date comparison.
exact_steps: If a full verified DOB is required for a scheme, use the current UIDAI process with an accepted Proof of Birth.
supporting_document_categories: Accepted Proof of Birth if a full DOB update is required
rules.official_source: Your Aadhaar - declared or approximate DOB (https://uidai.gov.in/en/contact-support/have-any-question/280-faqs/your-aadhaar.html)
rules.exact_support: UIDAI states that only year of birth is printed where DOB is declared or approximate.
rules.disclaimer: A matching year does not prove that complete dates are identical.

rules.recommended_action: Review the name recorded in PAN
rules.explanation: The name in PAN differs from uploaded evidence.
exact_steps: If you choose to update PAN, use a current authorised PAN Change/Correction route.
Check the current provider form for accepted supporting documents.
supporting_document_categories: Accepted supporting identity or change documents
rules.authority: Income Tax Department / authorised PAN service provider
rules.exact_support: The current provider form determines the required supporting documents.
rules.disclaimer: The exact procedure and supporting documents must be checked with the current authorised provider.

rules.explanation: Birth-record correction procedures vary by the registrar and jurisdiction.
exact_steps: Verify the original register and supporting records.
Contact the issuing Registrar of Births and Deaths for the current procedure.
supporting_document_categories: Case-specific supporting records requested by the Registrar
rules.official_source: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 - Section 15 (https://www.indiacode.nic.in/)
rules.exact_support: Section 15 addresses correction or cancellation of entries.
rules.disclaimer: Nirdosh Vault does not prescribe a universal affidavit, court, or registrar procedure.
